links.outcome: Retrieval coverage and complementarity of retrieved document sets across 500 Portuguese clinical queries
links.effect: BM25 and hybrid surfaced statistically distinct document sets (McNemar chi2 = 39.55, p < 0.001), with 680 sources unique to hybrid and 467 unique to BM25; dense-only retrieval failed for 22.2% of queries even at the most permissive threshold
links.quote: dense-only retrieval fails for 22.2% of clinical queries even at the most permissive threshold, making it structurally unsuitable as the sole retrieval path

design_hint: deterministic citation verification and hybrid retrieval grounding
